content: An gaiar, Tain qenen inmusub igo. Wo in qenungar igo eng sig-sig mom. End in wonou wau init qamb igo, in apand wonou wau. Munon Qenu me imbig igour end in wonou yurau eng gor me inimbigunerei.

An yonou munon banam ten. See in Qenu wonou wagrari. Ego in maigas at in wonou wagrari buruboun qi eng se me imbigoun. Mi eng gari imbigun. Munon inubersiau tari eng init dibeneriba. Ende aba ne in wo iitari buruboun.
Munon gugum munon inubersiau tari wot oabig qoat igour eng qenen qoregen igour, wonou iitari igour.
Munon qomon boru ebet igour eng Qenu wonou qomon biisitet igour. Qomon boru eng Qenu qomon omboariramau tari.
End an imbig igoumon eng, Munon inubersiau tari wo munon qomon boru ba at ariramb qamb init dibentar eng. End wo qomon boru ger bais wot me igo.
Munon gugum munon inubersiau tari nob igo eng qomon boru tandari me ubunerei.A munon qomon boru imusi-imusi ebet igo eng Krais me geau, ne gor wo me imbig igo.
An yonou wau gas, munon qei abari anmurimar me qomorunor. Your ger qoregen igo eng munon qoregen. Krais qoregen igo gas ende igo.
Munon ger qomon boru tandari ebet igo eng Satan wonou yurau. Satan wo qomon boru qanam bigor eng. Ne Qenu wonou wau dibentar eng Satan bumaimb qamb dererei.
Munon ger Qenu wonou wau igo gab eng qomon boru tandari me ebet igoriner. Qenu wonou boopuri ten igo end. End ne Qenu eng wonou Ur end tandari qomon boru me ebeiner.
In Qenu wonou wau ne Satan wonou wau, eng imbigub qamb eng ete: Munon ger gun eng wo qomon qoregen me ebet qiyo a munon qei me wurimbanamsi aba gab eng: “qo wo Qenu wau ue.”
3:11-18 Munon wuriqenungarau werei eng Yisas insirsiarei
An qob qoau qanambig igumon eng ete: in munon gugum qiqenunget igorun.
In munon Kein gas ende me oboun. Wo Satan wonou yurau. End wo wonou umour warama umor eng. Meimet qamb umour waramorei? Wo qomon boru ebet igoar end ne umour qomon uber ebet igama gab warama umorei.
An yonou munon banam, munon qei ansiningoar abari ibag an wurit uburab me isar.
In ininou munon banam wuriqenungar igoun end umau werei eng in mom wogub igomot igamau werei end igoun. A munon ger munon yurau qei me wuriqenungar eng wo mom umib qamb wonomi dui ebet igo.
Munon ger munon qei wurisiningoar igo eng wo munon igeig qoat. Munon igeig qoat eng wo bais igomot me igorinerei.
Yisas init wonomi dui umor gas ende in munon qei wurit igub in song umun. Munon qi qenungau qomon eng ende.
Munon ger mind irou igama ne qerei munon mi ue eng me wurisab igo. Wo ar igo ne qabarit qas, meimet qamb ye Qenu mom wot igub igoum, qamb igo?
In qabarit qas yonou munon banam ende me qomorun. Apand mom wuriqenungar ne wurimusiorun.
3:19-24 Yisas yurau Qenu menmant naget du qamb igorunor
In munon qei mom wuriqenungarun eng qob apand eng inboopuri ten igo eng imbig igoun. Ende imbig ne Qenu menmant sarog big igoun.
A ininou misirt ininou qomon qerei ne oau quguraget gab eng in ete imbigun: Qenu wo qoyam eng initanami igo. Wo qoyam aib.
End ne yonou munon banam, ete qemerine igar: Ininou misirt in qomon maigas at igoun qi eng qerei ne sigen misir igub eng Qenu menmant sarog big igoruboun.
In wonou qomon toat ne wo mi abar qamb qenunget igo eng in toat ebet igoun. End in mi geret qebi qomorun eng indariba.
Wo qomon ete abar qamb inimbiga: In wonou wau Yisas munon inubersiau tari end oabig ne munon qei wuriqenungarun wonou inimbigor gas ende oboun.

Munon ger Qenu wonou qomon toat igo eng wo git eng Qenu nob igama ne Qenu wo gor munon eng boopuri igo. Werei ende oboun eng Qenu in gugum inamar igoriba. Wonou Igomurur qau imurima init derer end in imbigoun, Qenu inboopuri igo.
